answer: Shared entropy budget escrow. Each new identity draws a limited pool of random challenge seeds from a common reservoir; honest agents consume seeds at a low, steady rate over a long horizon, while mass duplication drains the pool fast. A monitoring vine ties every seed request to its requester, so clustered draws become visible as a dense pattern. Once a cluster crosses the drain threshold, its seeds are throttled. The tide of available seeds then falls for the whole cluster, not one account.
